tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background; text grounds for `fg` and `muted`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar, status bar, cards, step rows, composer.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, avatar ground.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Log blocks and text fields: machine output sits on this.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the app in previews and on very wide screens.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline between regions and around cards. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls and fields; meets 3:1 on `bg`, `panel` and `inset`.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, metadata on `bg`, `panel`, `raised`, `inset`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, running state, focus ring, the current tab. The one identity colour.

tokens.name: accent-bg
tokens.usage: Selected navigation ground; `fg` reads on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `accent` primary button.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Completed state text and check mark on `bg` and `panel`.

tokens.name: wait
tokens.usage: Awaiting a person: state text, marks, border of question cards.

tokens.name: on-wait
tokens.usage: Text on a filled `wait` count badge.

tokens.name: wait-bg
tokens.usage: Question card ground; `fg`, `wait` and `muted` read on it.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Recovery wait and failure text and marks, Stop button.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for an inline failure message.

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Summary strip ground; `muted` reads on it.

tokens.name: lead-bg
tokens.usage: Card of a Thread with children being coordinated.

tokens.name: need-bg
tokens.usage: Monitor card awaiting a person.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Monitor card in recovery wait.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the thread drawer on phone width.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series: uncached input. Fill only, never text. Validated with chart-2 and chart-3 for colour-blind separation on `panel` in each theme.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series: cached input and cache rate. Fill and line only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series: output. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: logo-face
tokens.usage: Deep face keeps the light accent wink above the 3:1 graphical target.

tokens.name: logo-bright
tokens.usage: Approved bright bubble and eye details.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

tokens.name: motion-spin
tokens.usage: The running ring, the only moving thing. Stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-details
tokens.usage: Execution details width.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button and field height on desktop.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Control height on phone width.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Line icons.

brand.usage: Logo follows accent. Tile and wink use var(--accent); face and bright details use existing generated color-token mechanism. External favicon follows OS scheme, not app selection.
